name: Molecules
note: Molecule scenarios are dynamically built by buildScale3MoleculeDropdown() from molecules.js. The default is mol-h2.

scenarios.name: H₂ Hydrogen
scenarios.description: Simplest covalent molecule — two hydrogen atoms sharing electrons.

scenarios.name: O₂ Oxygen
scenarios.description: Diatomic oxygen — double bond, paramagnetic.

scenarios.name: N₂ Nitrogen
scenarios.description: Diatomic nitrogen — triple bond, extremely stable.

scenarios.name: HCl Hydrogen Chloride
scenarios.description: Polar covalent bond — electronegativity difference.

scenarios.name: H₂O Water
scenarios.description: Bent geometry (104.5°) — universal solvent, life's medium.

scenarios.name: NaCl Sodium Chloride
scenarios.description: Ionic bond — electrostatic attraction between Na⁺ and Cl⁻.

scenarios.name: He + Ne Noble Gases
scenarios.description: Van der Waals interaction only — no covalent or ionic bonds.

scenarios.name: CO₂ Carbon Dioxide
scenarios.description: Linear molecule (180°) — greenhouse gas, double bonds.

scenarios.name: NH₃ Ammonia
scenarios.description: Trigonal pyramidal (107.8°) — lone pair pushes geometry.

scenarios.name: H₂O₂ Hydrogen Peroxide
scenarios.description: O-O bond with dihedral angle — 3D geometry.

scenarios.name: H₂S Hydrogen Sulfide
scenarios.description: Bent geometry (92.1°) — compare with water's 104.5°.

scenarios.name: CH₄ Methane
scenarios.description: Perfect tetrahedral geometry (109.5°) — simplest alkane.

scenarios.name: C₂H₆ Ethane
scenarios.description: C-C single bond — two methyl groups in staggered configuration.

scenarios.name: C₂H₄ Ethylene
scenarios.description: C=C double bond — planar molecule, 120° angles.

scenarios.name: C₂H₂ Acetylene
scenarios.description: C≡C triple bond — linear molecule.

scenarios.name: CH₃OH Methanol
scenarios.description: Hydroxyl group (-OH) — simplest alcohol.

scenarios.name: CH₂O Formaldehyde
scenarios.description: C=O carbonyl group — trigonal planar geometry.

scenarios.name: C₆H₆ Benzene
scenarios.description: Aromatic ring — six-fold symmetry, delocalized electrons.

scenarios.name: C₂H₅OH Ethanol
scenarios.description: Common alcohol — C-C-O chain with hydroxyl group.

scenarios.name: CH₃COOH Acetic Acid
scenarios.description: Carboxyl group (-COOH) — simplest organic acid (vinegar).

scenarios.name: C₂H₅NO₂ Glycine
scenarios.description: Simplest amino acid — H₂N-CH₂-COOH, building block of proteins.

scenarios.name: CO(NH₂)₂ Urea
scenarios.description: First organic compound synthesized from inorganic — planar C center.

scenarios.name: C₅H₅N₅ Adenine
scenarios.description: Purine base — found in DNA, RNA, and ATP.

scenarios.name: C₈ Diamond Cell
scenarios.description: Diamond cubic unit cell — sp³ carbon network, hardest material.

scenarios.name: C₈H₁₀N₄O₂ Caffeine
scenarios.description: Purine alkaloid — the world's most consumed psychoactive substance.

scenarios.name: NaCl Crystal (3×3×3)
scenarios.description: Sodium chloride crystal lattice.

scenarios.name: Custom
scenarios.description: User-defined molecular configuration.
